sections.content: You know the *pluscuamperfecto* from B1 Unit 1: *había* or *habían* plus a participle looks back from one past moment to an earlier one. Here you use it for discoveries: a later realisation explains something that had already happened.

items.spanish: Me di cuenta de que alguien había dejado una pista bajo la puerta.
items.english: I realised that someone had left a clue under the door.

items.spanish: Cuando volvimos, vimos que alguien había dejado una pista en la mesa.
items.english: When we came back, we saw that someone had left a clue on the table.

items.spanish: No entendí la carta porque mi padre había guardado la primera página y yo había olvidado leerla.
items.english: I did not understand the letter because my father had kept the first page and I had forgotten to read it.

items.spanish: Cuando llegamos al café, ya habían cerrado.
items.english: When we got to the café, they had already closed.

sections.content: Do not use the *pluscuamperfecto* for every past verb. It marks the event that is earlier than the past moment you are narrating: *Llegué tarde porque había perdido el tren.*
